name: @kiwa-test/observability
description: Observability adapter for kiwa — flaky detection + spec coverage gap analysis + markdown dashboard + telemetry provider mocks (OpenTelemetry / Datadog / Sentry, v1.1) + Grafana-style dashboard + AlertManager routing + trace flame graph + log/span correlation (v2.0)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/index.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/collect.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/coverage.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/dashboard.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/flaky.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/spec-coverage.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**'
